documents.title: Refund policy
documents.body: Refunds are processed within five business days after approval. Annual plans can be refunded pro rata within thirty days. Contact billing@example.com with your invoice number.

documents.title: Shipping and delivery
documents.body: Physical add-ons ship within two business days. Tracking numbers are emailed on dispatch. Delivery takes three to seven business days depending on the region.

documents.title: Account management
documents.body: Owners can transfer workspace ownership, invite teammates by email, and enable two-factor authentication. Deleting an account removes all workspace data after a fourteen day grace period.

documents.title: Security and incident reporting
documents.body: Report suspected account compromise immediately to security@example.com. We revoke active sessions and require a password reset. Never share API keys in public repositories.

documents.title: Public API
documents.body: The REST API supports cursor pagination, idempotency keys, and webhooks. Rate limits are one hundred requests per minute per token. Authentication uses bearer tokens.

documents.title: Billing and invoices
documents.body: Invoices are issued on the first of each month. Update the billing email in settings. VAT invoices can be downloaded from the billing portal at any time.
